zh.title: 阻斷服務：從有限資源理解可用性
zh.summary: 服務依賴頻寬、連線、CPU、記憶體與後端容量。找出瓶頸與保護合法使用者的方式，比只看請求數更有用。
objectives: 區分流量增加、資源耗盡與惡意意圖。
用離線容量模型解釋限速與誤擋的取捨。

sections.heading: 可用性取決於最先耗盡的資源
paragraphs: DoS 讓合法使用者難以取得服務；DDoS 涉及分散來源的攻擊流量。瓶頸可能出現在網路、協定狀態或應用後端。便宜的請求若觸發昂貴查詢，請求數不高也可能造成壓力。
突然變慢也可能來自正當活動、故障或配置錯誤。要辨識原因，需要時間線、資源指標與請求特徵；不能只因流量變大就宣稱攻擊已成立。

sections.heading: 保護容量也要保留合法服務
paragraphs: 快取、請求成本限制、排隊、限速與上游防護各處理不同瓶頸。來源 IP 限速可能影響共用出口的正常使用者；只擴充主機，也不一定解決上游頻寬不足。
本單元以算術模型練習控制，不發送負載。真實壓力測試需要額外授權、流量上限、監控與停止條件，不能由一般網站測試授權推導。

example.title: 例子：每秒可以處理 100 單位工作
example.scenario: 合成服務每秒可處理 100 單位工作。一般請求成本 1，報表請求成本 20。每秒 4 個報表加上 30 個一般請求，共需 110 單位。
example.reasoning: 總共只有 34 個請求，但成本已超過容量。若先快取可重複使用的報表或限制昂貴路徑，可能比任意封鎖所有請求更能保留正常使用。
example.conclusion: 先定位工作成本與瓶頸；此模型沒有證明流量具有惡意。

lab.title: 離線練習：計算請求成本
lab.environment: 紙筆或本機計算機即可；不對網站送請求。
steps: 把報表降為每秒 3 個，重新計算。
寫出一個限速可能影響合法使用者的情境。
lab.expected: 原本成本 110；調整後為 90。模型中第二組低於容量，但還沒衡量真實延遲或突發。
lab.check: 為什麼 90 小於 100 仍不能保證真實系統永不逾時？
lab.cleanup: 保存計算與假設；沒有負載測試需要停止或回復。

en.title: Denial of service: understand availability through finite resources
en.summary: Services depend on bandwidth, connections, CPU, memory and backend capacity. Identify the bottleneck and how to preserve legitimate use instead of looking only at request counts.
objectives: Distinguish increased traffic, resource exhaustion and malicious intent.
Explain rate limits and false blocks with an offline capacity model.

sections.heading: Availability depends on the first exhausted resource
paragraphs: DoS interferes with legitimate access to a service; DDoS uses distributed attack traffic. A bottleneck may arise in networking, protocol state or an application backend. An inexpensive request that triggers a costly query can create pressure even at a modest request count.

A slowdown can also result from legitimate demand, failure or misconfiguration. Distinguishing causes requires a timeline, resource measures and request characteristics. A traffic increase alone does not establish an attack.

sections.heading: Protect capacity while preserving legitimate use
paragraphs: Caching, request-cost limits, queues, rate limits and upstream protection address different bottlenecks. Per-IP limits can affect legitimate users behind a shared gateway. Adding servers does not necessarily fix upstream bandwidth exhaustion.

This unit uses arithmetic rather than generating load. Real load testing requires separate authorization, bounded traffic, monitoring and stop conditions; ordinary website-testing permission does not imply it.

example.title: Example: capacity of 100 work units per second
example.scenario: A synthetic service processes 100 work units per second. A normal request costs 1 and a report costs 20. Four reports plus 30 normal requests per second require 110 units.
example.reasoning: There are only 34 requests, but their cost exceeds capacity. Caching reusable reports or limiting the costly path may preserve legitimate use better than indiscriminately blocking everything.
example.conclusion: Locate work cost and the bottleneck first. The model establishes no malicious intent.

lab.title: Offline exercise: calculate request cost
lab.environment: Use paper or a local calculator. Send no requests to a website.
steps: Calculate 4×20+30×1 and compare it with capacity 100.
Reduce reports to three per second and calculate again.
Describe one way rate limiting could affect a legitimate user.
lab.expected: The original cost is 110; the adjusted cost is 90. The second is below capacity in the model, but real latency and bursts remain unmeasured.
lab.check: Why does 90 being less than 100 not guarantee a real system will never time out?
lab.cleanup: Keep the calculation and assumptions. No load test needs stopping or rollback.

zh.prompt: 4 個成本 20 的請求加 30 個成本 1 的請求，總成本是多少？
rationales: 34 是請求數，不是工作成本。
這不是加權成本的結果。

en.prompt: What is the total cost of four requests costing 20 and thirty costing 1?
rationales: 34 is the request count, not work cost.
This is not the weighted cost.

zh.prompt: 流量突然增加能直接證明 DDoS 嗎？
options: 不能，還需來源、行為與資源等證據
不能，DDoS 從不影響流量
rationales: 正當活動也可能增加流量。
故障與配置也可能造成變慢。
攻擊可以影響流量；問題是證據不足。

en.prompt: Does a sudden traffic increase directly prove DDoS?
options: Yes; an increase is an attack
Yes, if the site slows down
No; source, behavior and resource evidence are needed
rationales: Failure or configuration can also cause slowdowns.
Separate the observed effect from its cause.
Attacks can affect traffic; the issue is insufficient evidence.
